### Everything Is Against Me!
Author: Derek Thomas
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/everything-against-me
Passage: Genesis 42:36
Points:
- Jacob despairs and assumes the worst based on limited, misleading information.
- Grief and hardship tempt believers to turn inward with self-centered pity.
- Jacob temporarily forgot God's covenant promises and providential care.
- While Jacob perceived hostility, God was actually preserving his entire family.
- Believers must interpret circumstances through God's promises rather than feelings.

### Father and Sons
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/father-and-sons
Passage: Genesis 42:35
Points:
- The brothers show emerging care and respect for their father's feelings.
- Finding the money in their sacks awakens deep conviction over past sins.
- God orchestrates stressful events to bring hidden guilt to repentance.
- Reuben's desperate pledge reflects genuine concern, despite poor judgment.
- Spiritual transformation shows itself in growing gentleness toward others.
